name: @foundry/read-focus
description: ReadFocus — fixation bolding, reading ruler and dyslexia-friendly fonts for any web page. Chrome extension (MV3).

scripts.zip: node build.js && cd dist && zip -qr ../read-focus.zip . && cd .. && ls -la read-focus.zip
scripts.zip:firefox: node build.js --firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../read-focus-firefox.zip . && cd .. && ls -la read-focus-firefox.zip
